'''Tinklewood''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] used to produce [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] rods, in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] fashioned splints out of Tinklewood fishing poles.
